Australia v Pakistan men's ODI scoring, over by over

aus_pak_overs.Rd

Runs and wickets in each over of every men's One Day International between Australia and Pakistan in the Cricsheet archive, with running totals for each innings.

Usage

aus_pak_overs

Format

A data frame with 4,153 rows and 10 columns:

match_id

Cricsheet match identifier

date

Date the match started

venue

Ground where the match was played

innings

Innings number (1 or 2); super overs are excluded

batting_team

Team batting in that innings

over

Over number, starting at 1

over_runs

Runs scored in the over, including extras

over_wickets

Wickets in the over, all dismissal types including run-outs

score

Cumulative runs at the end of the over

wickets

Cumulative wickets at the end of the over

Source

Ball-by-ball data from Cricsheet, https://cricsheet.org, downloaded with the cricketdata package. Cricsheet data is shared under an open-data licence, so check its current wording on the site and keep this credit in the README too.

Details

Matches shortened by rain have fewer overs, and an innings that ends early (all out or chase completed) stops at its final over. Match results are not included.
